FIELDS.NAME: Harmony Arts Academy
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Harmony Arts Academy, we specialize in providing high-quality dance, drama, and music education for students of all ages. Our operations include a range of classes and workshops designed to foster creativity and artistic expression in a safe and supportive environment. Our instructors are dedicated to maintaining the highest teaching standards. Our facility features modern amenities, including sprung floors for dance, soundproof music rooms, and secure performance spaces, all meticulously maintained to meet safety standards. Additionally, we conduct regular safety drills and maintain documented emergency response procedures to ensure a quick and effective response in any situation. We prioritize the well-being of our students, particularly those who are minors, by conducting thorough background checks on all staff members. Our commitment to ongoing professional development and safety training for instructors ensures that we consistently provide a nurturing atmosphere conducive to learning and growth. With a history of minimal claims and a strong risk management protocol in place, we are proud to offer an exceptional educational experience in the arts.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a dancer accidentally slipped during a rehearsal, resulting in minor injuries that required first aid treatment. The total incurred cost was $1,250.00, and the incident has been resolved with no ongoing claims.
FIELDS.ADDRESS:
456 Artistic Way, Studio B  
Springfield, IL 62704
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 8:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Sunday: Closed

FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Harmony Arts Academy does not store, treat, discharge, apply, dispose of, or transport hazardous materials in any of its operations. The focus is solely on providing arts education in a safe environment.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Harmony Arts Academy does not sponsor any athletic teams as our primary focus is on providing dance, drama, and music education. We concentrate on artistic instruction rather than athletic endeavors.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The director of operations is responsible for checking these certificates.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Harmony Arts Academy has not had any applicants indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. Our commitment to integrity and ethical practices underpins our operations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Harmony Arts Academy has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. All past coverage has been consistent and without issues.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Harmony Arts Academy does not lease employees to or from other employers. All staff members are directly employed by the academy.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Harmony Arts Academy carries workers' compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and to protect both employees and the organization against workplace injuries.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Harmony Arts Academy also operates Harmony Dance and Music Studio, which focuses on similar educational offerings in the arts. This allows us to expand our reach and enhance our service to the community.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Harmony Arts Academy does not currently have any other insurance policies with this company. All existing coverage is listed under the current policy number.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Harmony Arts Academy is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging products. Our focus is solely on providing arts education through dance, drama, and music classes.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Harmony Arts Academy does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our focus is solely on providing high-quality dance, drama, and music education within our facility.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Harmony Arts Academy has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years, indicating stable financial management.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Harmony Arts Academy does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals in its operations, as our focus is solely on providing arts education in a safe environment.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Harmony Arts Academy does not have any catastrophe exposure in its operations. We focus solely on providing arts education in a safe environment without engaging in high-risk activities.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Harmony Arts Academy has not experienced any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. Our commitment to safety and compliance ensures a supportive environment for all students and staff.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Harmony Arts Academy has no uncorrected fire code violations and maintains compliance with all safety regulations. Regular inspections and maintenance ensure the facility meets necessary safety standards.
